class TomlError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line):
        super().__init__(f"{message} (line {line})")
        self.message = message
        self.line = line


_BARE = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-")

        self.i = 0
        self.n = len(text)
        self.root = {}
        self.cur = self.root
        self.explicit = set()

    def err(self, msg, pos=None):
        pos = self.i if pos is None else pos
        line = self.t.count("\n", 0, pos) + 1
        raise TomlError(msg, line)

    def peek(self, off=0):
        j = self.i + off
        return self.t[j] if j < self.n else ""

    def skip_comment(self):
        if self.peek() == "#":
            while self.peek() not in ("", "\n"):
                self.i += 1

    def skip_blank(self):
        # whitespace, comments and newlines

            c = self.peek()
            if c in (" ", "\t", "\r", "\n"):
                self.i += 1
            elif c == "#":
                self.skip_comment()
            else:

def digits(rng, length):
    out = str(rng.randint(1, 9))

def gen_scalar(rng):
    """Return (toml_text, python_value) for one scalar."""
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.26:                                   # int
        text = rng.choice(["", "-", "+"]) + digits(rng, rng.randint(1, 6))

    if r < 0.46:                                   # float

        node = gen_node(rng)
        lines.append(render_kv(k, node, rng))

        lines.append("")
        lines.append("# section " + ".".join(path))
        lines.append("[" + ".".join(path) + "]")
        used_keys = set()
        for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 5)):
